a: Veen lahen machshava.
Amar leh: machshava geredta la ka mibbaya leh, ki ka mibbaya leh – machshavto nikkeret mittoch maasav.
Kegon dahava kayyma ola baddarom, veatyay batztzafon veshachta, may? middeatyay batztzafon veshachta ikkavven la, o dilma makom hu dela itremi leh?
Ha name amra rabbi yochanan chada zimna, ditnan: hammaale perotav laggag mippene hakkenima, veyarad alehem tal – enan bechi yuttan", veim nitkavven lechach – hare hen bechi yuttan".
Heelum cheresh shote vekatan, af al pi shennitkavvevnu lechach, enan bechi yuttan", mippene sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machshava.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shello hippech bahen, aval hippech bahen – hare ze bechi yuttan".
Hachi ka mibbaya leh: deorayyta o derabbanan?
Rav nachman bar yitzchak matne hachi: amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, bae rabbi yochanan: katan yesh lo maase o en lo maase?
Amar leh rabbi amme: vetibbee leh machshava! may shena machshava dela ka mibbaya leh? ditnan: en lahen machshava. maase name la tibbee leh, ditnan: yesh lahen maase.

Hachi ka mibbaya leh: deorayyta o derabbanan? ufashet: yesh lahen maase, vaafillu middeorayyta, en lahen machshava, vaafillu midderabbanan. machshavto nikkeret mittoch maasav – middeorayyta en lo, midderabbanan yesh lo.

Bea minneh shemuel merav huna: minnayin lammitassek bekadashim shehu pasul? shenneemar: "veshachat et ben habbakar", shettehe shechita leshem ben bakar. amar lo: zo beyadenu hi, leakkev minnayin? talmud lomar: "lirtzonchem tizbachuhu", ledatechem zevuchu.
Mishna shechitat nochri nevela, umetammea bemassa.
Gemara nevela – in, issur hanaa – la. man tanna? amar rabbi chiyyay berabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan: dela kerabbi eliezer, dei rabbi eliezer – haamar: setam machshevet nochri laavoda zara.

Rabbi amme amar: hachi katane, shechitat nochri – nevela, ha demin – laavoda zara. tenena leha detanu rabbanan: shechitat min laavoda zara, pitto – pat kuti, yeno – yen nesech, sefarav – sifre kosmin, perotav – tevalin, veyesh omrim: af
b: Banav mamzerin.
Vetanna kamma, ishto la mafkar.
Amar mar: shechitat nochri nevela, venechush shemma min hu? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: en minin baummot.
Veha kachazenan deikka? ema: en rov ummot minin, savar la ki ha deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: goyim shebbechutza learetz lav ovde avoda zara hen, ella minhag avotehen bidehen.

Amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: en minin baummot. lemay? ilema lishchita, hasheta shechitat min deyisrael amrat asira, degoy mibbaya? ella lemoridin, hasheta deyisrael moridin, degoyim mibbaya?
Amar rav ukeva bar chama: lekabbel mehen korban, detanya: "mikkem" velo kullechem, lehotzi et hameshummad, "mikkem" – bachem chillakti velo baummot.

Mimmay? dilma hachi kaamar: miyyisrael – mitztzaddike kabbel, merashshie la tekabbel, aval beummot haolam – kelal kelal la! la salka datach, detanya: "ish" – ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot haggoyim, shennodrim nedarim unedavot keyisrael.

Umetammea bemassa. peshita, kevan dinvela hi metammea bemassa! amar rava: hachi katane, zo metammea bemassa, veyesh lecha acheret shehi metammea afillu beohel, veezo zo? tikrovet avoda zara, ucherabbi yehuda ben betira.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: hachi katane, zo metammea bemassa, veyesh lecha acheret shehi kazo shemmetammea bemassa veenah metammea beohel, veezo zo? tikrovet avoda zara, udela kerabbi yehuda ben betira.

Detanya, rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: minnayin letikrovet avoda zara shehi metammea beohel? shenneemar: "vayyitztzamdu levaal peor vayyochlu zivche metim", ma met metamme beohel, af tikrovet avoda zara metammea beohel.
Mishna hashshochet ballayla, vechen hassome sheshshachat – shechitato keshera.
Gemara hashshochet diavad – in, lechattechilla – la. ureminhi: leolam shochatin, ben bayyom uven ballayla, ben berosh haggag ben berosh hassefina!
Amar rav pappa: besheavuka kenegdo. amar rav ashe: dayka name, dekatane hatam dumeya deyom, vehacha dumeya desome, shema minna.

a: Mishna hashshochet beshabbat uveyom hakkippurim, af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho – shechitato keshera.
Gemara amar rav huna, darash chiyyay bar rav mishshemeh derav: asura baachila leyoma, venasvin chavrayya lememar rabbi yehuda hi.

He rabbi yehuda? amar rabbi abba: rabbi yehuda dahachana hi, ditnan: mechattechin et haddilluin lifne habbehema veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim. rabbi yehuda omer: im lo hayta nevela meerev shabbat asura, lefi sheenah min hammuchan. alma, kevan dela ittechan meetmol – asura, hacha name, kevan dela ittechan meetmol – asura.

Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam meikkara muchan leadam, vehasheta muchan lichlavim. hacha meikkara muchan leadam, vehasheta muchan leadam! mi savrat behema bechayyeha laachila omedet? behema bechayyeha legaddel omedet!
I hachi, behema lerabbi yehuda beyom tov hechi shachatinan? amar lo: omedet laachila veomedet legaddel, nishchata – huverra delaachila omedet, lo nishchata – huverra dilgaddel omedet.
Veha let leh lerabbi yehuda berera! mena lan? i nema middetanya:

Hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim, omer: "shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish hare hen teruma, asara maaser rishon, tisha maaser sheni", umechel veshote miyyad, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin.
b: Hatam kidkatane tama, amru lo lerabbi meir: "i atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod venimtza shote tevalim lemafrea?" amar lahen: "lichsheyyibbaka".
Ella middetane ayyo.
Detane ayyo, rabbi yehuda omer: en adam matne al shene devarim keechad, ella im ba chacham lammizrach – eruvo lammizrach, lammaarav – eruvo lammaarav, veillu lechan ulechan – la.
Vehavenan ba: may shena lechan ulechan dela, deen berera? mizrach umaarav name en berera!
Veamar rabbi yochanan: uchevar ba chacham.

Ella amar rav yosef: rabbi yehuda dechelim hi, ditnan: kol hakkelim hannittalin bashshabbat, shivrehen nittalin, uvilvad sheyyehu osin meen melacha. shivre areva – lechassot bahen pi chavit, shivre zechuchit – lechassot bahen pi happach.
Rabbi yehuda omer: uvilvad sheyyehu osin meen melachtan, shivre areva – latzuk letochan mikpa, shivre zechuchit – latzuk letochan shemen.
Meen melachtan – in, meen melacha acheret – la; alma, kevan dela ittechan meetmol lehach melacha – asiri; hacha name, kevan dela ittechan meetmol – asura.
Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam meikkara keli, vehasheta shever keli, vehave leh nolad, veasur. hacha meikkara uchela, ulevassof ochel, uchela deipperat hu.
Veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar: uchela deipperat shappir dame, ditnan: en sochatin et happerot lehotzi mehen mashkin, veim yatzu meatzman – asurin.
Rabbi yehuda omer: im loochalin – hayyotze mehen muttar, veim lemashkin – hayyotze mehen asur.
Lav ittemar ala, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: mode haya rabbi yehuda lachachamim besalle zetim vaanavim.
Alma, kevan delischita kayymi – yahev dateh; hacha name, kevan delishchita kayyma – yahev dateh.
Midde hu tama, ella lerav, haamar rav: chaluk haya rabbi yehuda afillu besalle zetim vaanavim.
Ella amar rav sheshet bereh derav idi: rabbi yehuda denerot hi, detanya: metaltelin ner chadash, aval lo yashan, divre rabbi yehuda.
Emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda bemuketze mechamat mius, muketze mechamat issur mi shamat leh? in, ditnan: rabbi yehuda omer:

a: Kol nerot shel mattechet mittaltelin, chutz min hanner shehidliku bo beotah shabbat.
Vedilma shane hatam, dehu dache leh beyadayim!
Ella amar rav ashe: rabbi yehuda dimvashshel hi, ditnan: hamevashshel beshabbat, beshogeg – yeachel, bemezid – lo yeachel, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda omer: beshogeg – yeachel bemotzae shabbat, bemezid – lo yeachel olamit.
Rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer: beshogeg – yeachel lemotzae shabbat laacherim velo lo, bemezid – lo yeachel olamit, lo lo velo laacherim.
Venokma bemezid, verabbi meir!
La salka datach, dekatane dumya deyom hakkippurim – ma yom hakkippurim la shena beshogeg vela shena bemezid – la achel, af hacha name la shena beshogeg vela shena bemezid – la achel.
Umi matzet mokmat la beshogeg verabbi yehuda? veha "af al pi shemmitchayyev benafsho" katane! hachi kaamar: af al pi divmezid mitchayyev benafsho hu, hacha divshogeg – shechitato keshera.

Venokma kerabbi yochanan hassandelar, deamar: la shena beshogeg vela shena bemezid – la achel! rabbi yochanan hassandelar kamfalleg bemotzae shabbat, laacherim velo lo, tanna didan "shechitato keshera" katane, la shena lo vela shena laacherim.
Tane tanna kammeh derav: hamevashshel beshabbat, beshogeg – yeachel, bemezid – lo yeachel, umeshattek leh rav.
May tama meshattek leh? illema mishshum disvira leh kerabbi yehuda, vetanna tane kerabbi meir, mishshum disvira leh kerabbi yehuda, man detane kerabbi meir meshattek leh?!
Veod, mi savar la kerabbi yehuda? vehaamar rav chanan bar amme: ki mori lehu rav letalmideh – more lehu kerabbi meir, vechi daresh befirka – daresh kerabbi yehuda, mishshum amme haaretz!
Vechi tema: tanna befirkeh tena kammeh, attu kulle alma letanna tzayyti? leamora tzayyti!

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tanna shochet tena kammeh derav: hashshochet beshabbat, beshogeg – yeachel, bemezid – lo yeachel. amar leh: may dataych kerabbi meir? ad kan la kashare rabbi meir ella bimvashshel, derauy lachos, aval shochet deen rauy lachos – la!
Veha matnitin deshochet hu, veamar rav huna: daresh chiyyay bar rav mishshemeh derav: asura baachila leyoma, venasvin chavrayya lememer: rabbi yehuda hi, ha rabbi meir share!
Ki share rabbi meir,
b: Kegon shehaya lo chole mibbeod yom.
I hachi, may tama derabbi yehuda deasar? kegon shehaya lo chole vehivri.
Vechi ha deamar rav acha bar adda amar rav, veamri la amar rabbi yitzchak bar adda amar rav: hashshochet lachole beshabbat – asur labbari, hamevashshel lachole beshabbat – muttar labbari.
May tama? hay rauy lachos, vehay eno rauy lachos.
Amar rav pappa: peamim shehashshochet muttar, kegon shehaya lo chole mibbeod yom; mevashshel asur, kegon shekkatzatz lo dallaat.

Amar rav dimi minnehardea, hilcheta: hashshochet lachole beshabbat – muttar labbari beumetza, may tama? kevan dei efshar lichzayit basar belo shechita, ki ka shachet – addata dechole ka shachet. hamevashshel lachole beshabbat – asur labbari, gezera shemma yarbe bishvilo.
Mishna hashshochet bemaggal yad, betzor, uvekane – shechitato keshera.
Hakkol shochatin, uleolam shochatin, uvakkol shochatin, chutz mimmaggal katzir, vehammegera, vehashshinnayim, vehatztzipporen, mippene shehem chonkin.

Gemara hashshochet – diavad in, lechattechilla la. bishlama bemaggal yad – dilma ate lemebad beiddach gisa, ella tzor vekane lechitchilla la? ureminhi: bakkol shochatin, ben betzor, ben bizchuchit, ben bikrumit shel kane!

La kashya: kan betalush, kan bimchubbar. deamar rav kahana: hashshochet bimchubbar lakkarka – rabbi posel verabbi chiyyay machshir; ad kan la ka machshir rabbi chiyyay ella bediavad, aval lechattechilla la.

Bemay okemta kerabbi chiyyay vediavad? ella ha detanya: bakkol shochatin, ben betalush ben bimchubbar, ben shehassakkin lemala vetzavvar behema lematta, ben shehassakkin lematta vetzavvar behema lemala – manni? la rabbi vela rabbi chiyyay! i rabbi chiyyay – diavad in, lechitchilla la; i rabbi – diavad name la.
Leolam rabbi chiyyay, vaafillu lechattechilla, vehay dekamippalgi bediavad – lehodiacha kocho derabbi.
Veella, matnitin dekatane "hashshochet", diavad – in, lechattechilla – la, manni? la rabbi vela rabbi chiyyay, i rabbi chiyyay – afillu lechattechilla, i rabbi – diavad name la.
Leolam rabbi chiyyay, vaafillu lechattechilla, umatnitin dekatane "hashshochet" – rabbi hi.
Kashya derabbi adderabbi? la kashya: kan bimchubbar meikkaro, kan betalush ulevassof chibbero.

Umena temra deshane lan ben mechubbar meikkaro letalush ulevassof chibbero? detanya: hashshochet bemucheni – shechitato keshera, bimchubbar lakkarka – shechitato keshera, naatz sakkin bakkotel veshachat bah – shechitato keshera, haya tzor yotze min hakkotel o kane ole meelav veshachat bo – shechitato pesula.

a: Kashyayn ahadade! ella lav shema minna shane ben mechubbar meikkaro letalush ulevassof chibbero, shema minna.
Amar mar: hashshochet bemucheni shechitato keshera, vehatanya: shechitato pesula! la kashya: ha besarna defachra, ha besarna demayya.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha besarna demayya, vela kashya: ha bechoach rishon, ha bechoach sheni.

Vechi ha deamar rav pappa: hay man dechafteh lechavreh veashkel aleh bidka demayya umit – chayyayv. may tama? gire dideh hu deahani beh. vehane mille – bechoach rishon, aval bechoach sheni – gerama bealma hu.

Yatev rav achoreh derabbi chiyyay, verabbi chiyyay kammeh derabbi, veyatev rabbi vekaamar: minnayin lishchita shehi betalush? shenneemar: "vayyikkach et hammaachelet lishchot". amar leh rav lerabbi chiyyay: may kaamar? amar leh: vav dichtiv aufeta kaamar. veha kera kaamar! kera zerizuteh deavraham ka mashma lan.

Amar rava: peshita li, talush ulevassof chibbero leinyan avoda zara have talush, deamar mar: hammishtachave levayit shello asaro, vei salka datach have mechubbar – "elohehem al heharim" velo heharim elohehem.
Leinyan hechsher zeraim tannae hi, ditnan: hakkofe keara al hakkotel bishvil shettudach – hare ze bechi yuttan", bishvil shello yilke hakkotel – eno bechi yuttan".
Ha gufa kashya: amrat, bishvil shettudach – hare ze bechi yuttan", ha bishvil sheyyudach hakkotel – en ze bechi yuttan".
Vahadar tane: bishvil shello yilke hakkotel – eno bechi yuttan", ha bishvil sheyyudach hakkotel – hare ze bechi yuttan".
Amar rabbi elazar: tivra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo. rav pappa amar: kullah chad tanna hu, ha bakkotel meara, ha bechotel binyan.
Vehachi kaamar: hakkofe keara al hakkotel bishvil shettudach – hare ze bechi yuttan", ha bishvil sheyyudach hakkotel – en ze bechi yuttan".
Bamme devarim amurim? bechotel meara, aval bechotel binyan – bishvil shello yilke hakkotel hu deeno bechi yuttan", ha bishvil sheyyudach hakkotel – hare ze bechi yuttan".
Bae rava:
b: Talush ulevassof chibbero leinyan shechita may?
Ta shema: haya tzor yotze min hakkotel, o shehaya kane ole meelav veshachat bo – shechitato pesula.
Hacha bemay askinan? bechotel meara. dayka name, dekatane dumeya dekane ole meelav", shema minna.
Ta shema: naatz sakkin bakkotel veshachat bah – shechitato keshera. shane sakkin, dela mevattel leh.
Ta shema: bimchubbar lakkarka shechitato keshera. dilma paroshe ka mefaresh la – may "mechubbar lakkarka"? sakkin, dela mevattel leh.

Amar mar: naatz sakkin bakkotel veshachat bah, shechitato keshera. amar rav anan amar shemuel: lo shanu ella shehassakkin lemala vetzavvar behema lematta, aval sakkin lematta vetzavvar behema lemala – chayyshinan shemma yidros.
Veha katane: ben shehassakkin lematta vetzavvar behema lemala, ben shehassakkin lemala vetzavvar behema lematta!
Amar rav zevid: litzdadin katane, sakkin lematta vetzavvar behema lemala – betalush, sakkin lemala vetzavvar behema lematta – bimchubbar. rav pappa amar: beofa dekallil.

Amar rav chisda amar rabbi yitzchak, veamri la bematnita tana: chamishsha devarim neemru bikrumit shel kane: en shochatin bah, veen malin bah, veen mechattechin bah basar, veen mechatztzetzin bah shinnayim, veen mekannechim bah.
En shochatin bah, vehatanya: bakkol shochatin, ben betzor, ben bizchuchit, ben bikrumit shel kane! amar rav pappa: besimona deagma.
Veen mechattechin bah basar. rav pappa mechattech ba kirve dagim, dezigi. rabba bar rav huna mechattech ba ofa derakkich.
Veen mekannechin ba, tippok leh mishshum deamar mar: hamekanneach bedavar shehaur sholetet bo shinnav noshrot. amar rav pappa: kinnuach pi makka kaamrinan.
Hakkol shochatin, uleolam shochatin. hakkol shochatin – hakkol bishchita, vaafillu of.

Leolam shochatin, man tanna? amar rabba: rabbi yishmael hi, detanya: "ki yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulecha kaasher dibber lach veamarta ochla vasar vegomer", rabbi yishmael omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella lehattir lahem besar taava.
Shebbattechilla, neesar lahem besar taava, mishshennichnesu laaretz huttar lahem besar taava.
Veachshav sheggalu, yachol yachzeru leissuran harishon? lechach shaninu: leolam shochatin.

Matkef la rav yosef: hay "leolam shochatin", "leolam shochatin veochlin" mibbee leh! veod, meikkara may tama ittesar – mishshum dehavu mekarvi lemishkan, ulevassof may tama ishtero – dahavo merachaki mimmishkan,

a: Vechol shekken hasheta dearchiku lehu tefe.

Ella amar rav yosef: rabbi akiva hi, detanya: "ki yirchak mimmecha hammakom asher yivchar Adonai elohecha lasum shemo sham vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha", rabbi akiva omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella leesor lahen besar nechira, shebbattechilla huttar lahen besar nechira, mishshennichnesu laaretz neesar lahen besar nechira.
Veachshav sheggalu, yachol yachzeru lehetteran harishon? lechach shaninu: leolam shochatin.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi akiva savar: besar taava la ittesar kelal, rabbi yishmael savar: besar nechira la ishteri kelal.
Bishlama lerabbi yishmael, hayeynu dichtiv "veshachat et ben habbakar", ella lerabbi akiva may "veshachat"? kadashim shane.

Bishlama lerabbi yishmael, hayeynu dichtiv "hatzon uvakar yishshachet lahem", ella lerabbi akiva may "hatzon uvakar yishshachet lahem"? "yinnacher lahem" mibbee leh! nechira shellahen zo hi shechitatan.
Bishlama lerabbi yishmael – hayeynu ditnan: hashshochet venitnabbela beyado, vehannocher vehameakker – patur millechassot, ella lerabbi akiva ammay patur millechassot?
Hoil veittesar, ittesar.
Bishlama lerabbi akiva, deamar besar taava la ittesar kelal – hayeynu dichtiv: "ach kaasher yeachel et hatztzevi veet haayyal ken tochlennu", ella lerabbi yishmael, tzevi veayyal gufeh mi have shere?
Ki asar rachamana – behema dechazya lehakerava, aval chayya dela chazya lehakerava – la asar rachamana.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: evre besar nechira shehichnisu yisrael immahen laaretz, mahu?
Emat? illema besheva shekkibbeshu – hasheta davar tame ishteri lehu, dichtiv: "uvattim meleim kol tuv", veamar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav: kutle dachazire – besar nechira mibbaya?
Ella, leachar mikkan. veibbaet ema: leolam besheva shekkibbeshu, ki ishteri lehu shalal shel goyim – didhu la ishteri. teku.
Amar rabba: shannet "hakkol shochatin" uleolam shochatin", "bakkol shochatim" – may meshannet leh?
Vechi tema, ben betzor ben bizchuchit ben bikrumit shel kane, ha dumeya dehanach katane; i hanach beshochatin – hay name beshochatin, vei hanach benishchatin – hay name benishchatin.

Ella amar rava: "hakkol shochatin", chada leetoye kuti, vachada leetoye yisrael meshummad. "leolam shochatin" – ben bayyom ben ballayla, ben berosh haggag ben berosh hassefina. "bakkol shochatin" – ben betzor, ben bizchuchit, ben bikrumit shel kane.
Chutz mimmaggal katzir vehammegera. avu dishmuel pegam veshaddar, pegam veshaddar. shelachu leh: kimgera shaninu.
Tanu rabbanan:
b: Sakkin sheyyesh bah pegimot harebe – tiddon kimgera, vesheen bah ella pegima achat: ogeret – pesula, mesuchesechet – keshera. hechi damya ogeret? hechi damya mesuchesechet? amar rabbi eliezer: ogeret – mishte ruchot, mesuchesechet – meruach achat.

May shena mishte ruchot, demuresha kamma machlesh umuresha batra baza? meruach achat name, churepa desakkina machlesh, muresha baza! dekaem aresha desakkina. sof sof, ki azla machlesha, ki (ata beza) [atya baza]! kegon sheholich velo hevi.

Amar rava: shalosh middot besakkin – ogeret – lo yishchot, veim shachat – shechitato pesula. mesuchesechet – lo yishchot bah lechitchilla, veim shachat – shechitato keshera. ole veyored besakkin – shochet bah lechattechilla.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav nechemya lerav ashe: amart lan mishshemeh derava: mesuchesechet pesula, veha amar rava: mesuchesechet keshera! la kashya: kan sheholich vehevi, kan sheholich velo hevi.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: damya lesasa, may? amar leh: man yahev lan mibbisreh veachlinan.
Amar rav chisda: minnayin livdikat sakkin min hattora? shenneemar: "ushechattem baze vaachaltem".

Peshita, kevan dechi nekav terefa, baaya bedika lechacham kaamrinan! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: lo amru lehareot sakkin lechacham ella mippene kevodo shel chacham! midderabbanan, ukera asmachta bealma hu.
Bemareva badki la beshimsha, binhardea badku la bemayya, rav sheshet badek la beresh lishshaneh, rav acha bar yaakov badek la bechut hassaara.
Besura amri: bisra achla, bisra livdeka. amar rav pappa: tzericha bedika abbisra, veattufera, veattelata ruchata.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: amar lan rav samma bereh derav mesharsheya mishshemach, daamart leh mishshemeh derava: tzericha bedika abbisra veattufera veattelata ruchata. amar leh: abbisra veattufera amari, veattelata ruchata la amari. ikka deamri: abbisra veattufera veattelata ruchata amari, mishshemeh derava la amari.

Ravina verav acha bereh derava havo yatvi kammeh derav ashe, ayyto sakkin lekammeh derav ashe livdeka. amar leh lerav acha bereh derava: bidka. badka attufera veabbisra veattelata ruchata. amar leh: yishar, vechen amar rav kahana.

Rav yemar amar: attuvfra veabbisra tzericha, attelata ruchata la tzericha. mi la amar rabbi zera amar shemuel: libben sakkin veshachat bah – shechitato keshera, shechiddudah kodem lelibbunah; vekashya lan: haikka tzedadin! veamrinan: bet hashshechita mirvavch ravavch. hacha name, bet hashshechita mirvavch ravavch.
Amar rav huna bar rav kattina amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, shalosh pegimot hen: pegimat etzem bappesach, pegimat ozen bivchor, pegimat mum bekadashim.
Verav chisda amar: af pegimat sakkin. veiddach bechullin la ka mayyre.
Vechullan, pegimatan kede pegimat hammizbeach.

a: Vechamma pegimat hammizbeach? kede shettachgor bah tzipporen.
Metivi: kamma pegimat hammizbeach? rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: tefach, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kezayit. la kashya: ha besida, ha beavna.
Amar rav huna: hay tabbacha dela sar sakkina kamme chacham – meshammetinan leh, verava amar: meabberinan leh, umachrezinan abbisreh ditrefa hi.
Vela peligi, kan – beshennimtzet sakkino yafa, kan – beshello nimtzet sakkino yafa. ravina amar: hecha delo nimtzet sakkino yafa – memasmes leh befarta, daafillu legoyim name la mizdabban.

Hahu tabbacha dela sar sakkina kammeh derava bar chinnana, shammeteh veabbereh, veachrez abbisreh ditrefa hi. ikkelau mar zutera verav ashe legabbeh, amar lehu: liayyeynu rabbanan bemilleteh, ditlu beh tafle.
Badke rav ashe lesakkineh, venimtzet yafa, veachshereh. amar leh mar zutera: vela lechush mar lesava? amar leh: shelichuteh ka avdinan.
Amar rabba bar huna: shen telusha vetzipporen telusha muttar lishchot bah lechattechilla. veha anan tenan: chutz mimmaggal katzir vehammegera vehashshinnayim vehatztzipporen, mippene shehen chonkin.
Shen ashshen – la kashya: ha bachada, ha betarte. tzipporen atztzipporen – la kashya: ha bitlusha, ha bimchubberet.
Mishna hashshochet bemaggal katzir, badderech halichatah – bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. veim hechliku shinneha – hare hi kesakkin.

Gemara amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: af keshehichshiru bet hillel, lo hichshiru ella letaharah mide nevela, aval baachila asura. amar rav ashe: dayka name, dekatane "bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin", vela katane "bet shammay osrin uvet hillel mattirin". velitamaych, litne "bet shammay metammein uvet hillel metaharin"! ella, poslin umachshirin veosrin umattirin – chada milleta hi.
Mishna hashshochet mittoch hattabbaat, veshiyyer bah melo hachut al pene kullah – shechitato keshera. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: melo chut al pene rubbah.
Gemara rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: halacha kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda, veaf rabbi yose berabbi yehuda lo amar ella betabbaat haggedola, hoil umakkefet et kol hakkane, aval bishar tabbaot – lo.
Uvishar tabbaot lo? vehatanya: rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer:
b: Hashshochet bishar tabbaot, af al pi sheen makkifot et kol hakkane, hoil umakkifot et rov hakkane – shechitato keshera, umugeremet pesula. heid rabbi chanina ben antignos al mugeremet shehi keshera.
Amar rav yosef: rabbi yose bar yehuda tarte kaamar. rav ushemuel savri kevavteh bachada, ufeligi aleh bachada.
Veha "lo amar" kaamri? hachi kaamar: halacha kemoto betabbaat haggedola, veen halacha kemoto bishar tabbaot.
Ki selek rabbi zera, achal mugeremet derav ushemuel. amri leh: lav meatreh derav ushemuel at? amar lehu: man amra? yosef bar chiyyay! yosef bar chiyyay mikkulle alma gemir.

Shema rav yosef, ikkefad, amar: ana mikkulle alma gemirna? ana merav yehuda gemirna, daafillu sefeke degavre gares. deamar rav yehuda: amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba, safek mishshemeh derav, safek mishshemeh dishmuel: shelosha mattirin et habbechor bimkom sheen mumeche.
Verabbi zera, let leh notnin alav chumere hammakom sheyyatza mishsham vechumere hammakom shehalach lesham?
Amar abbaye: hane mille mibbavel levavel, umeeretz yisrael leeretz yisrael, i name meeretz yisrael levavel, aval mibbavel leeretz yisrael, kevan daanan kayyfinan lehu – avdinan kevavtayyhu.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema mibbavel leeretz yisrael, hane mille hecha dedato lachazor, rabbi zera en dato lachazor hava.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: veha rabbanan daato mimmachoza amri, amar rabbi zera mishshemeh derav nachman: mugeremet keshera! amar leh: nahara nahara ufeshateh.
Rabbi shimon ben lakish achshar bechudda dechovaa, kare aleh rabbi yochanan: gisa gisa, amar rav pappi mishshemeh derava: pega bechitte – terefa.
Ibbaya lehu: paga venaga bahen, dichtiv "vayyifga bo vayyamot", o dilma paga velo naga, kedichtiv "vayyifgeu vo malache elohim"?

Ittemar, amar rav pappa mishshemeh derava: shayyayr bechitte – keshera. amar rav ammemar bar mar yanoka: hava kaemna kammeh derabbi chiyyay bereh derav avya, veamar li: shayyayr bechitte – keshera. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: amar li rav shemen missuvera, ikkela mar zutera leatrin uderash: shayyayr bechitte – keshera. mar bar rav ashe amar: pega bechitte – keshera, shayyayr bechitte – terefa.

a: Vehilcheta mishshippuy kova ulematta – keshera, vehayeynu deshayyayr bechitte.
Rav nachman achshar mishshippuy kova ulematta, amar leh rav chanan bar rav kattina lerav nachman: keman? la kerabbanan vela kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda.

Amar leh: ana la chilak yadana vela bilak yadana, ana shemata yadana, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rabbi chanina, veamri lah amar rabbi yaakov bar idi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mishshippuy kova ulematta keshera.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mugeremet derabbanan keshera lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Uderabbi yose berabbi yehuda, keshera lerabbi chanina ben antignos.
Peshita! mahu detema: rabbi chanina ben antignos adderabbanan kae, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name? im ken, "heid aleha" mibbee leh. vehilcheta kerabbi chanina ben antignos, dekae rav nachman kevavteh.
Amar rav huna amar rav assi: machloket besheshshachat shene shelish vehigrim shelish, derabbanan savri: kulla shechita baenan betabbaat gedola, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar: rubbo kechullo.
Aval higrim shelish, veshachat shene shelish – divre hakkol pesula, dechi nafka chiyyuta baenan rubba bishchita, velekka.
Amar leh rav chisda: adderabba, lema mar ippecha: machloket keshehigrim shelish, veshachat shene shelish, derabbi yose berabbi yehuda savar midde dehave achatzi kane pagum.
Verabbanan, hatam makom shechita, hacha lav mekom shechita.
Aval shachat shene shelish, vehigrim shelish – divre hakkol keshera, deha tenan: rubbo shel echad kamohu.
Amar leh rav yosef: man nema lan dehahu rubba dehatam lav rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane la? dilma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane la!
Amar leh abbaye: attu kol rubbe dealma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane lehu? amar leh: ana rubba dishchita kaamena, dishmana lehu difligi.

Lishshana acharina amri la, amar rav huna amar rav assi: machloket shehigrim shelish veshachat shene shelish, derabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda savar: midde dehave achatzi kane pagum, verabbanan – hatam mekom shechita, hacha lav mekom shechita.
Aval shachat shene shelish, vehigrim shelish – divre hakkol keshera, deha tenan: rubbo shel echad kamohu.

Matkef la rav chisda: man lema lan dehahu rubba dehatam lav rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane la? dilma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane la! amar leh rav yosef: attu kol rubbe dealma rabbi yose berabbi yehuda katane lehu? amar leh: ana rubba dishchita kaamena, dishmana lehu difligi.

Higrim shelish, veshachat shelish, vehigrim shelish – rav huna amar rav: keshera, rav yehuda amar rav: terefa. rav huna amar rav: keshera – ki nafka chiyyuta bishchita ka nafka. rav yehuda amar rav: terefa – baenan rubba bishchita velekka.

Shachat shelish, vehigrim shelish, veshachat shelish – rav yehuda amar rav: keshera. ato shayylu lerav huna, amar lehu: terefa. shema rav yehuda ikkefad, amar: tarefna (vamekasher) [machshar], (vamekasheranea) [machsharna] taref! amar rav huna: shappir ka mikkefad, chada – ihu shemia leh minneh derav, vaana la shemia li, veod – haikka rubba bishchita.
Amar leh rav chisda: la tehdar bach,
b: Deim ken, mafsedat la lekammayyta. hatam may tama ka machsherat? dechi nafka chiyyuta – behechshera ka nafka. hacha name, ki nafka chiyyuta – behagerama ka nafka.

Ikkela rav nachman lesura, beo minneh: shachat shelish vehigrim shelish veshachat shelish, mahu? amar lehu: lav hayeynu derabbi elazar bar minyome, deamar rabbi elazar bar minyome: shechita haasuya kemasrek keshera.
Vedilma bimkom shechita! bimkom shechita may lememra? mahu detema: baenan shechita meforaat velekka, ka mashma lan.
(Siman: bakkad).
Yetev rabbi abba achoreh derav kahana, veyatev rav kahana kammeh derav yehuda, veyatev vekaamar: shachat shelish vehigrim shelish veshachat shelish, mahu? amar leh: shechitato keshera.
Higrim shelish veshachat shelish vehigrim shelish, mahu? amar leh: shechitato pesula.
Shachat bimkom nekev, mahu? amar leh: shechitato keshera.
Shachat ufaga bo nekev, mahu? amar leh: shechitato pesula.
Azal rabbi abba, amra kammeh derabbi elazar, azal rabbi elazar, amra kammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: may shena?
Amar leh: shachat bimkom nekev, naasa kemi sheshshachat goy vegamar yisrael. shachat ufaga bo nekev, naasa kemi sheshshachat yisrael vegamar goy. kare aleh: "goy goy".

Amar rava: shappir kare aleh "goy goy", bishlama hatam middahava leh leyisrael lemishchat rubba vela shechat, ki nafka chiyyuta – bida degoy ka nafka, ella hacha mikkede mishchat shachet, ma li bimkom nekev, ma li paga bo nekev?

Mishna hashshochet min hatztzedadin – shechitato keshera, hammolek min hatztzedadin – melikato pesula. hashshochet min haoref – shechitato pesula, hammolek min haoref – melikato keshera. hashshochet min hatztzavvar – shechitato keshera, hammolek min hatztzavvar – melikato pesula, shekkol haoref kasher limlika, vechol hatztzavvar kasher lishchita. nimtza, kasher bishchita – pasul bimlika, kasher bimlika – pasul bishchita.
Gemara may oref? ilema oref mammash, may irya shochet? afillu molek name! "mimmul orpo" amar rachamana, velo orpo. ella may oref? mimmul oref, kidkatane sefa: kol haoref kasher limlika.

Menahane mille, detanu rabbanan: "mimmul orpo" – mul haroe et haoref, vechen hu omer: "vehu yoshev mimmuli", veomer: "ki fanu elay oref velo fanim". may veomer? vechi tema: oref gufeh la yadinan hecha, denidda mul dideh hecha – ta shema: "ki fanu elay oref velo fanim", mikkelal deoref lahade panim.
Amri bene rabbi chiyyay: mitzvat melika machazir simanim laachore haoref umolek. ikka deamri: af machzir, veikka deamri: machzir davka.
Umistabbera keman deamar af machzir, mimmay? middekatane: hashshochet min haoref – shechitato pesula, hammolek min haoref – melikato keshera,

a: Vei salka datach machzir davka, may irya molek? afillu shochet name! ella lav shema minna af machzir, umatnitin bidla ahdar.

Amar rabbi yannay: yekabbelu harovin et teshuvatan, dekatane: nimtza kasher bishchita – pasul bimlika, kasher bimlika – pasul bishchita. lemaote may? lav lemaote machazir simanin laachore haoref, dela?
Amar rabba bar bar chana: la, lemaote shen vetzipporen. shen vetzipporen behedya katane lehu.

Ella amar rabbi yirmeya: lemaote molich umevi. hanicha leman deamar molich umevi bimlika – pasul, ella leman deamar kasher, may ikka lememar? bene rabbi chiyyay savri la keman deamar molich umevi bimlika – pasul.

Amar rav kahana: mitzvat melika kotzetz veyored, vezo hi mitzvatah. savar rabbi avin lememar: kotzetz veyored – in, molich umevi – la. amar leh rabbi yirmeya: kol shekken demolich umevi bimlika kasher, umay zo hi mitzvatah? ema: af zo hi mitzvatah.

Amar rabbi yirmeya amar shemuel: kol hakkasher bishchita – kenegdo baoref kasher bimlika, ha pasul bishchita – pasul bimlika. lemaote may? illema lemaote ikkur simanin, veha tane rame bar yechezkel: en ikkur simanin baof!
Amar rav pappa: lemaote rosho. rosho peshita? "mimmul orpo" amar rachamana, velo berosho!

May "rosho"? shippuy rosho, kegon denaket mishshippuy rosho vehigrim vaazal ad dimta tattay, vechidrav huna amar rav assi, deamar rav huna amar rav assi: higrim shelish veshachat shene shelish – pesula.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: ha detane rame bar yechezkel en ikkur simanin baof, la amaran ella leman deamar en shechita laof min hattora,
b: Aval leman deamar yesh shechita laof min hattora, yesh ikkur.
Amar leh: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera! leman deamar yesh shechita laof min hattora, ikka lememar dehachi agmereh deen ikkur, vaafillu leman deamar kivhema, leinyan ikkur la leheve kivhema.
Ella leman deamar: en shechita laof min hattora ella middivre sofrim, mehecha gemiri la? mibbehema, kulla milleta kivhema!

Amar ravina, amar li ravin bar kisi: ha detane rame bar yechezkel, en ikkur simanin baof – la amaran ella bimlika, aval bishchita yesh ikkur. vehaamar rabbi yirmeya amar shemuel: kol hakkasher bishchita kenegdo baoref kasher bimlika, ha pasul – pasul! hahi peliga.
Amar zeeri: nishbera mafreket verov basar immah – nevela.
Amar rav chisda: af anan name tenena, malak besakkin – metamme begadim abbet habbelia, vei amrat terefa havya, melikatah zo hi shechitatah – tahane la sakkin letaharah mide nevela.
Amri: hatam mishshum delav shechita hi kelal. may tama? rav huna amar: mippene shehu machlid, rava amar: mippene shehu dores.

Man deamar mippene shehu machlid, may tama la amar mippene shehu dores? kasavar: molich umevi bimlika kasher. uman deamar mippene shehu dores, may tama la amar mippene shehu machlid? amar lach: chalada hechi dame? kechuleda haddara beikkere vattim demikkasseya, hacha ha miggalleya.
Amar rava: i kashya li ha kashya li, vechi meta omed umolek?
Amar leh abbaye: vetikshe lach olat haof, devaaya shene simanin, vechi meta omed umolek? amar leh: hatam kede lekayyem bah mitzvat havedala.
I hachi, or name! kol hameakkev bishchita meakkev behavedala, vechol sheeno meakkev bishchita eno meakkev behavedala.
Veha miut simanin lerabbanan, dela miakkevi bishchita, umeakkevi behavedala! ella ema: kol sheyyeshno bishchita yeshno behavedala, vechol sheeno bishchita eno behavedala.

a: Mikkol makom kashya! amar rava, ema: vechen hu ose – chotech shidra umafreket belo rov basar.

Ki salek rabbi zera, ashkecheh lerabbi amme deyatev vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh: vechi meta omed umolek? eshtomam keshaa chada, amar leh: ema, kach hu ose: chotech shidra umafreket belo rov basar.

Tanya name hachi: ketzad molkin chattat haof? chotech shidra umafreket belo rov basar ad shemmaggia lavvevshet o lakkane; higgia lavvevshet o lakkane, chotech siman echad o rubbo verov basar immo, uveola shenayim o rov shenayim.
Manni? i rabbanan – ha amri: shenayim davka! i kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon – haamar: rov shenayim!
Ema: shenayim – lerabbanan, rov shenayim – lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, veibbaet ema: ha veha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon, umay shenayim – sheddomin lishnayim.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: nishbera mafreket verov basar immah – metamme beohel.

Veim tomar: oto maase deeli, mafreket belo rov basar havay! zikna shane, dichtiv: "vayhi kehazekiro et aron haelohim vayyippol meal hakkisse achorannit bead yad hashshaar vattishshaver mafrakto vayyamot ki zaken haish vechaved vegomer".
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: kerao kaddag – metamme beohel. amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak: umiggabbo.
Amar shemuel: asaah gistera – nevela. amar rabbi elazar: nittal hayyarech vechalal shellah (nikkar) – nevela. hechi dame chalal shellah (nikkar)? amar rava: kol shervutza veniret chasera.
Tenan hatam: huttezu rashehen, af al pi shemmefarkesin – temeim, kiznav halletaa shemmefarkeset.
May huttezu? resh lakish amar: huttezu mammash, rabbi assi amar rabbi mani: kehavedalat olat haof.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi assi: kehavedalat olat haof lerabbanan, vela peligitu, o dilma kehavedalat olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, ufeligitu?
Amar leh: kehavedalat olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, ufeliginan.
Ikka deamri: rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: huttezu mammash, rabbi assi amar rabbi mani: kehavedalat olat haof lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon berov shenayim.
May rabbanan umay rabbi elazar berabbi shimon? detanya: "veet hashsheni yaase ola kammishpat" – kemishpat chattat behema.

Atta omer kemishpat chattat behema, o eno ella kemishpat chattat haof? keshehu omer "vehikrivo", chillek hakkatuv ben chattat haof leolat haof, uma ani mekayyem "kammishpat" – kemishpat chattat behema. ma chattat behema enah baa
b: Ella min hachullin, uvayyom, uveyado hayemanit, af olat haof enah baa ella min hachullin uvayyom uveyado hayemanit.
I ma lehallan berov shenayim, af kan berov shenayim? talmud lomar "umalak vehiktir" – ma haketara harosh beatzmo vehagguf beatzmo, af melika harosh beatzmo vehagguf beatzmo.
Rabbi yishmael omer: "kemishpat" – kemishpat chattat haof, ma chattat haof mimmul oref, af olat haof mimmul oref.
I ma lehallan, molek veeno mavdil besiman echad, af kan molek veeno mavdil besiman echad? talmud lomar "vehikrivo".
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: "kammishpat" – "kemishpat chattat haof", ma lehallan

a: Ochez barosh uvagguf umazze, af kan ochez berosh uvagguf umazze.
May kaamar? hachi kaamar: ma lehallan, keshehu achuz harosh bagguf mazze, af kan, keshehu achuz harosh bagguf mazze.
I ma lehallan besiman echad, af kan besiman echad? talmud lomar "vehikrivo".
Vetanna kamma, vechi meachar denafka lan miumalak … vehiktir", "vehikrivo" lema li?
I lav "vehikrivo", hava amena: may "kammishpat" – kemishpat chattat haof.
Vei mishshum "umalak vehiktir" – hava amena: ma haketara berosho shel mizbeach – af melika berosho shel mizbeach.
Hasheta dichtav rachamana "vehikrivo", derosh beh name ha.
Chattat behema, deenah baa ella min hachullin, menalan? amar rav chisda, deamar kera: "vehikriv aharon et par hachattat asher lo" – mishshello, velo mishshel tzibbur, velo mishshel maaser.
Bayyom – mibbeyom tzavvoto" nafka! kedi nasva.
Yado hayemanit – midderabba bar bar chana nafka, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kol makom shenneemar etzba o chehunna enah ella yamin.
Veiddach, kehunna baaya etzba, etzba la baaya kehunna.
Vetanna kamma verabbi elazar berabbi shimon, mimmul haoref mena lehu? gamri melika mimmelika.
Mishna kasher betorin – pasul bivne yona, kasher bivne yona – pasul betorin, techillat hatztzihuv baze uvaze – pasul.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: torin gedolim – kesherim, ketannim – pesulim; bene yona ketannim – kesherim, gedolim – pesulin. nimtza kasher betorin – pasul bivne yona, kasher bivne yona – pasul betorin.
Tanu rabbanan: "torim" – gedolim velo ketannim, sheyyachol vahalo din hu:
b: Uma bene yona shello hucheshru bigdolim hucheshru biktannim, torim shehucheshru bigdolim eno din shehucheshru biktannim? talmud lomar: "torim" – gedolim velo ketannim.

"Bene yona" – ketannim velo gedolim, sheyyachol vahalo din hu: uma torim shello hucheshru biktannim – hucheshru bigdolim, bene yona shehucheshru biktannim – eno din shehucheshru bigdolim? talmud lomar "bene yona" – ketannim velo gedolim.
May talmuda? amar rava: la lishtemit kera velichtov "min bene hattorim o min hayyona".

Ema: bene yona dichtav behu rachamana "bene" – ketannim in, gedolim la, torim – i bae gedolim layyte, i bae ketannim layyte! dumya divne yona: ma bene yona – ketannim in, gedolim la, af torim – gedolim in, ketannim la.

Tanu rabbanan: yachol yehu kol hattorim vechol bene hayyona kesherim? talmud lomar: "min hattorim" – velo kol hattorim, "min bene hayyona" – velo kol bene yona, perat litchillat hatztzihuv shebbaze veshebbaze sheppasul. meematay hattorim kesherim – mishsheyyazhivu, meematay bene yona pesulin – mishsheyyatzhivu.
Tane yaakov karcha: meematay bene yona kesherim? mishsheyyealu. hu tane la vehu amar la, "efrochav yealu dam". emat? amar abbaye: mikki shamet gadpa mineh veate dema.
Bae rabbi zera: haomer "hare alay ola min hattorim o min bene hayyona", vehevi techillat hatztzihuv shebbaze veshebbaze, mahu? sefeka have venafek, o dilma beriyya have vela nafek?
Amar rava, ta shema: perat litchillat hatztzihuv shebbaze veshebbaze, sheppasul. i amrat bishlama beriyya have – shappir, ella i amrat sefeka have, itzterich kera lemaote sefeka?

a: Ki itzterich kera lemaote nirba veneevad.

Salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "ki moshchatam bahem mum bam", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: kol makom shenneemar hashechata, eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara; devar erva, dichtiv: "ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz";

Avoda zara, dichtiv: "pen tashchitun vaasitem lachem pesel", kol shehammum posel bo – devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bo, vechol sheen hammum posel bo – en devar erva vaavoda zara poslin bo. vehane ofot, hoil vela pasel behu muma, deamar mar: tammut vezachrut bivhema veen tammut vezachrut beofot, ema devar erva vaavoda zara name la lifsol behu – ka mashma lan.
Bae rabbi zera: haomer "hare alay olat behema min haayil o min hakkeves", vehevi palgas, mahu?
Allibba derabbi yochanan la tibbee lach, deamar beriyya have, ditnan: hikrivo – mevi alav niske ayil, veen ole lo mizzivcho.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: "o laayil", lerabbot et happalgas.
Ki tibbee lach allibba devar peda,
b: Deamar mayyte umatne.
Mi amrinan: ayil vacheves matne, bivriyya la matne, o dilma bivriyya name matne, deamar: i beriyya have – leheve kulleh nedava? teku.
Bae rabbi zera: haomer "hare alay lachme toda min hechametz o min hammatztza", vehevi siur, mahu?
Siur deman? i siur derabbi meir – lerabbi yehuda matztza meallayyta hi.
I derabbi yehuda, lerabbi meir – chametz hu.
Vei derabbi meir, lerabbi meir, middelake aleh – chametz hu.
Ella derabbi yehuda lerabbi yehuda, may? sefeka have, venafek mimma nafshach, o dilma beriyya hu, vela nafek?
Vehaamar rav huna: haomer "hare alay lachme toda" – mevi toda velachmah, vechevan deichayyayv leh betoda velachmah, ha la yada hay gavra i chametz hu delayte matztza, i matztza hu delayte chametz!
La tzericha, deamar "hare alay challa liftor todato shel peloni".
Sof sof ha la yada hay gavra, i chametz hu delayte matztza, i matztza hu delayte chametz! la tzericha, dela amar "liftor", mippak gavra yede nidro nafek o la nafek? teku.
Mishna kasher bappara – pasul baegla, kasher baegla – pasul bappara.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: para bishchita keshera, baarifa pesula; egla baarifa keshera, bishchita pesula; (nimtzet) [nimtza] kasher bappara – pasul baegla, kasher baegla – pasul bappara.
Utehe para keshera baarifa mikkal vechomer: uma egla shello hucheshra bishchita – hucheshra baarifa, para shehucheshra bishchita – enah din shehucheshra baarifa?

a: Amar kera "veshachat" vechukka: bishchita in, baarifa la.
Vechol hecha dichtiv beh chukka, la darshinan kal vachomer? veha gabbe yom hakkippurim, dichtiv beh chukka, vetanya: "veasahu chattat" – haggoral ose chattat, veen hashshem ose chattat.

Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma bimkom shello kiddesh haggoral, kiddesh hashshem, mekom shekkiddesh haggoral, eno din shekkiddesh hashshem? talmud lomar: "veasahu chattat", haggoral ose chattat, veen hashshem ose chattat.
Tama dichtav rachamana "veasahu chattat", ha lav hachi darshinan kal vachomer!
Mayet rachamana gabbe egla haarufa, "zot" baarifa, veen acheret baarifa.

Utehe egla keshera bishchita mikkal vachomer: uma para shello hucheshra baarifa – keshera bishchita, egla shekkeshera baarifa – eno din shehucheshra bishchita? amar kera: "vearfu haegla" – baarifa in, bishchita la.
Mishna kasher bakkohanim pasul balviyyim, kasher balviyyim pasul bakkohanim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: kohanim, bemumin – pesulim, beshanim – kesherim. leviyyim, bemumin – kesherim, beshanim – pesulim. nimtza kasher bakkohanim – pasul balviyyim, kasher balviyyim – pasul bakkohanim.

Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "zot asher lalviyyim" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "umibben chamishshim shana yashuv", lamadnu lalviyyim shehashshanim poslin bahem. yachol mumin poslin bahem? vedin hu: uma kohanim sheen hashshanim poslin bahen, mumin poslin bahen – leviyyim shehashshanim poslin bahem, eno din sheyyehu mumin poslin bahem? talmud lomar: "zot asher lalviyyim" – zot lalviyyim, veen acheret lalviyyim.

Yachol yehu hakkohanim pesulin beshanim? vahalo din hu: uma leviyyim sheen mumin poslin bahem – shanim poslin bahem, kohanim shehammumin poslin bahem – eno din sheyyehu shanim poslin bahem? talmud lomar: "asher lalviyyim" – velo asher lakkohanim.
Yachol af beshilo uvevet olamim ken? talmud lomar "laavod avodat avoda vaavodat massa", lo amarti ella bizman shehaavoda bakkatef.

Katuv echad omer: "mibben chamesh veesrim shana vamala", vechatuv echad omer: "mibben sheloshim", i efshar lomar sheloshim, shekkevar neemar chamesh veesrim, vei efshar lomar chamesh veesrim, shekkevar neemar sheloshim. ha ketzad? chamesh veesrim letalmud, usheloshim laavoda.
Mikkan letalmid shello raa siman yafe bemishnato chamesh shanim – shuv eno roe. rabbi yose omer: shalosh shanim, shenneemar: "ulegaddelam shanim shalosh", "ulelammedam sefer uleshon kasdim".
Veiddach – shane leshon kasdim, dekallil. veiddach – shane hilchot avoda, detakkifin.

Tanu rabbanan: kohen mishsheyyavi shete searot ad sheyyazkin – kasher laavoda, umumin poslin bo. ben levi mibben sheloshim vead ben chamishshim kasher laavoda, veshanim poslin bo. bamme devarim amurim? beohel moed shebbammidbar, aval beshilo uvevet olamim en nifsalin ella bekol. amar rabbi yose: may kera?
b: "Vayhi cheechad lamchatztzetzorim velamshorrim lehashemia kol echad".
Ad sheyyazkin – ad kamma? amar rabbi ila amar rabbi chanina: ad sheyyerattet.
Tenan hatam: baal keri shettaval velo hetil mayim, lichsheyyatil – tame. rabbi yose omer: bechole uvezaken – tame, beyeled uvevari – tahor.

Yeled ad kamma? amar rabbi ila amar rabbi chanina: kol sheomed al raglo achat vecholetz minalo venoel minalo. amru alav al rabbi chanina, shehaya ben shemonim shana vehaya omed al raglo achat vecholetz minalo venoel minalo. amar rabbi chanina: chammin vashemen shessachatni immi beyalduti hen amdu li beet ziknuti.

Tanu rabbanan: nitmalle zekano, rauy leasot sheliach tzibbur, velered lifne hatteva, velissa et kappav. meematay kasher laavoda? mishsheyyavi shete searot. rabbi omer: omer ani, ad sheyyehe ben esrim.
Amar rav chisda: may tama derabbi? dichtiv: "vayyaamidu [et] haleviyyim mibben esrim shana vamala lenatztzeach al melechet bet Adonai", veiddach – "lenatztzeach" shane.
Veha hay kera bilviyyim ketiv? kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beesrim vearbaa mekomot nikreu kohanim "leviyyim", veze echad mehen: "vehakkohanim haleviyyim bene tzadok".

Tanu rabbanan: "ish mizzaracha ledorotam", mikkan amar rabbi elazar: katan pasul laavoda, vaafillu tam. meematay kasher laavoda? mishsheyyavi shete searot, aval echav hakkohanim en mannichin oto laavod ad sheyyehe ben esrim.
Ikka deamri: ha rabbi hi, vaafillu pasul derabbanan let leh. veikka deamri: rabbi it leh pasul midderabbanan, veha rabbanan hi, ulechattechilla hu dela, aval diavad – avodato keshera.
Mishna tahor bichli cheres – tame bechol hakkelim, tahor bechol hakkelim – tame bichli cheres.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: avir keli cheres tame, vegabbo tahor. avir kol hakkelim tahor, vegabban tame. nimtza, tahor bichli cheres tame bechol hakkelim, tahor bechol hakkelim tame bichli cheres.
Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "tocho", veaf al pi shello naga.

Atta omer af al pi shello naga, o eno ella im ken naga? rabbi yonatan ben avtulemos omer: neemar "tocho" letamme, veneemar "tocho" littamme, ma "tocho" haamur letamme af al pi shello naga, af "tocho" haamur littamme af al pi shello naga.
Vehatam menalan? amar rabbi yonatan: hattora heida al keli cheres

a: Vaafillu melo chardal.

Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: vihe keli cheres mittamme miggabbo, mikkal vechomer: uma kol hakkelim sheen mittammein meaviran – mittammein miggabban, keli cheres shemmittamme meaviro – eno din sheyyetamme miggabbo?

Amar kera: "vechol keli fatuach asher en tzamid patil alav", ezehu keli shettumeato kodemet lefitcho? heve omer: ze keli cheres, vechi en tzamid patil alav hu detame, ha yesh tzemid patil alav – tahor.
Veyihyu kol hakkelim mittammein meaviran, mikkal vachomer: uma keli cheres sheen mittamme miggabbo – mittamme meaviro, kol hakkelim shemmittammein miggabban – eno din shemmittammein meaviran?
Amar kera "tocho", tocho shel ze, velo tocho shel acher.
Vehane "tocho", ha darshinhu!
Arbea "tocho" ketivi: "tocho", "toch"; "tocho", "toch".
Chad legufeh, vechad ligzera shava, vechad "tocho shel ze velo tocho shel acher", vechad "tocho velo toch tocho", vaafillu keli shetef.

Velo yehu kol hakkelim mittammein miggabban, ella mittochan uvingia, mikkal vechomer: uma keli cheres shemmittamme meaviro – eno mittamme miggabbo, kol hakkelim sheen mittammein meaviran – eno din sheen mittammein miggabban?

Amar kera: "vechol keli fatuach asher en tzamid patil alav tame hu", hay hu dechi en tzamid patil alav tame, ha yesh tzamid patil alav tahor. ha kol hakkelim, ben sheyyesh tzamid patil alehem ben sheen tzamid patil alehem – mittammein.
Mishna tahor bichle etz, tame bichle mattachot; tahor bichle mattachot, tame bichle etz.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: golme keli etz temein, peshutehen tehorin; golme kele mattachot tehorin, peshutehen temein. nimtza tahor bichle etz – tame bichle mattachot, tahor bichle mattachot – tame bichle etz.
Veellu hen golme kele etz: kol sheatid lashuf, leshabbetz, legarer, lecharkev, lehatiach betunas, mechussar kan o ogen o ozen – tame, mechussar chatita – tahor.
Mechussar chatita, peshita! la tzericha, dechak kefiza bekabba.
Veellu hen golme kele mattachot: kol sheatid
b: Lashuf, leshabbetz, legarer, lecharker, lehakkish bekurenas. mechussar kan o ogen o ozen – tahor, mechussar kesuy – tame.
May shena hane umay shena hane? rabbi yochanan amar: hoil ulechavod asuyin. rav nachman amar: hoil udemehen yekarim.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu kele etzem, veazda rav nachman letameh, deamar rav nachman: kele etzem kichle mattachot damu.

Mikkelal dichle etzem mekabbeli tumea? in, detanya: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: ma talmud lomar "vechol maase izzim titchattau"? lehavi davar habba min haizzim, min hakkarnayim umin hattelafayim. shear behema vechayya minnayin? talmud lomar "vechol maase". im ken, ma talmud lomar "izzim"? perat leofot.
Mishna hachayyayv bishkedim hammarim – patur bammetukim, hachayyayv bammetukim – patur bammarim.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: shekedim hammarim, ketannim – chayyayvin, gedolim – peturin. metukim, gedolim – chayyayvin, ketannim – peturin.
Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: ze vaze liftur, veamri la: ze vaze lechiyyuv. amar rabbi ila: hora rabbi chanina betzippori kedivre haomer ze vaze liftur.
Uleman deamar ze vaze lechiyyuv, gedolim lemay chazu? amar rabbi yochanan: hoil veyachol lemattekan al yede haur.
Mishna hattemed, ad shello hechmitz – eno nikkach bechesef maaser, ufosel et hammikve. mishshehechmitz – nikkach bechesef maaser, veeno posel et hammikve.
Haachin hashshuttafin, keshechayyayvin bakkalbon – peturin mimmasar behema; keshechayyayvin bemasar behema – peturin min hakkalbon.
Gemara manni matnitin? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbanan, detanya: hametammed venatan mayim bammidda umatza kede middato – patur, verabbi yehuda mechayyev.
Manni? i rabbanan – af al gav dehechmitz, i rabbi yehuda – af al gav delo hechmitz! amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu:

a: Beshehechmitz machloket, umatnitin rabbi yehuda. vechen amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: beshehechmitz machloket.
Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: temed shellekacho bechesef maaser, ulevassof hechmitz – kana maaser. may tama? iggallay milleta lemafrea defera hu.
Ella, matnitin dekatane hechmitz – in, lo hechmitz – la, dilma i shavkeh hava machmitz! amar rabba: kesheshshiyyer mimmennu bechos velo hechmitz.
Rava amar: ha manni? rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi, ditnan: shelosha luggin mayim chaser kuretov, shennafal letochan kuretov yayin, umarehen kemare yayin, venaflu lammikve – lo pesaluhu.
Shelosha luggin mayim chaser kuretov, shennafal letochan kuretov chalav, umarehen kemare mayim, venaflu lammikve – lo pesaluhu.
Rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: hakkol holech achar hammare.
Lav amar rabbi yochanan: batar chazuta azlinan? hacha name zil batar chazuta, vetama vachazuta dehay mayya ninhu.
Ufeliga derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: hakkol modim sheen mafrishin alav mimmakom acher, ella im ken hechmitz.
Kasavar belo hechmitz machloket, vead kan la mechayyev rabbi yehuda ella minneh uveh, aval mealma la, dilma ate leafroshe min hachiyyuv al happetur umin happetur al hachiyyuv.
Tanu rabbanan: hattemed ad shello hechmitz –
b: Mashshiko bammayim, mishshehechmitz – en mashshiko bemayim. amar rava: lo shanu ella shettimmedo bemayim tehorim venitmeu, aval temeim meikkara – la.

Azal rav geviha mibbe chetil, amra lishmata kammeh derav ashe, may shena temein meikkara dela, deamrinan: ayyeyde demayya yakkiri shochni tattay, ufera kafe milleel, vela ka salka lehu hashshaka lemayya. i hachi, tehorim ulevassof nitmeu name.
Ella, mevalbeli; hacha name – mevalbeli.
Mishna kol makom sheyyesh mecher, en kenas, vechol makom sheyyesh kenas, en mecher.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim amru: yesh kenas bimkom mecher, detanya: ketanna mibbat yom echad ad shettavi shete searot – yesh lah mecher veen lah kenas, mishshettavi shete searot ad shettivgar – yesh lah kenas veen lah mecher, divre rabbi meir, shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol makom sheyyesh mecher – en kenas, vechol makom sheyyesh kenas – en mecher.
Vachachamim omrim: ketanna mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad ad shettivgar – yesh lah kenas.
Kenas – in, mecher – la? ema: af kenas bimkom mecher.
Mishna kol makom sheyyesh meun – en chalitza, vechol makom sheyyesh chalitza – en meun.

Gemara amar rav yehuda, amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: yesh meun bimkom chalitza, detanya: ad matay habbat memaenet? ad shettavi shete searot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyirbe hashshachor al hallavan.
Mishna kol makom sheyyesh tekia – en havedala, vechol makom sheyyesh havedala – en tekia.
Yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat – tokin, velo mavdilin; bemotzae shabbat – mavdilin, velo tokin.
Ketzad mavdilin? "hammavdil ben kodesh lekodesh". rabbi dosa omer: "ben kodesh chamur lekodesh hakkal".
Gemara hechi tokea? amar rav yehuda: tokea umeria mittoch tekia, verav assi amar: tokea umeria binshima achat. atken rav assi behutzal kishmateh.

Metivi: yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, tokin velo meriin. may lav lo meriin kelal? la, rav yehuda metaretz letameh verav assi metaretz letameh. rav yehuda metaretz letameh: la meriin bifne atzmah, ella mittoch tekia. verav assi metaretz letameh: la meriin bishte neshimot, ella binshima achat.
Uvemotzae shabbat kulei. hecha amar la? amar rav yehuda: bachatimatah, vechen amar rav nachman: bachatimatah.
Verav sheshet bereh derav idi amar: af biftichatah, velet hilcheta kevavteh.
Rabbi dosa omer: "ben kodesh chamur lekodesh hakkal", velet hilcheta kevavteh.

Amar rabbi zera: yom tov shechal lihyot beemtza shabbat, omer "hammavdil ben kodesh lechol uven or lechoshech uven yisrael laggoyim uven yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase", may tama? seder havedalot hu mone.
Hadaran alach hakkol shochatin.

a: Mishna hashshochet echad baof ushenayim babbehema – shechitato keshera, verubbo shel echad kamohu. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyishchot et havvevridin. chatzi echad beof veechad vachetzi bivhema – shechitato pesula. rov echad baof verov shenayim babbehema – shechitato keshera.
Gemara "hashshochet" – diavad in, lechattechilla la. shenayim babbehema lechitchilla la? ad kamma lishchot velezil? ibbaet ema: aechad baof, veibbaet ema: arubbo shel echad kamohu.
(360 Siman).

Amar rav kahana: minnayin lishchita shehi min hatztzavvar? shenneemar: "veshachat et ben habbakar", mimmakom sheshshach chattehu. mimmay dehay chattehu lishshana dedakkoye hu? dichtiv: "vechitte et habbayit", veibbaet ema mehacha: "techatteeni veezov veethar".
Veema mizzenavo? shach – mikkelal shezzakuf baenan, veha shach veomed hu. veema meozno? baenan dam hannefesh, velekka.
Veema: dekara veazel ad dam hannefesh! vetu, shehiyyay, derasa, chalada, hagerama, veikkur – menalan? ella gemara. shechita min hatztzavvar name gemara.
Ukera lemay ata? dela leshavveyay gistera.
Rav yemar amar: amar kera "vezavachta", mimmakom shezzav chattehu. may mashma dehay chattehu lishshana demitbar hu? dichtiv: "al tira veal techat".
Veema mechotmo, zav al yede chittuy baenan, vehay zav meelav hu. veema millibbo, vetu: shehiyyay, derasa, chalada, hagerama, veikkur – menalan? ella gemara. shechita min hatztzavvar name gemara.
Ukera lemay ata? dela leshavveyeh gistera.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "veshachat" – al tikre "veshachat" ella "vesachat", mimmakom shessach chattehu.
Veema milleshono! baenan dam hannefesh velekka, veema dekara veazel ad dam hannefesh! vetu, shehiyyay derasa chalada hagerama veikkur menalan? ella gemara, shechita min hatztzavvar name gemara.
Ukera lemay ata? dela leshavveyeh gistera.
Vetanna mayyte la mehacha, detanya: rabbi chiyyay amar: minnayin lishchita min hatztzavvar? shenneemar: "vearchu bene aharon hakkohanim et hannetachim".

Sheen talmud lomar "et harosh veet happader", ma talmud lomar "et harosh veet happader"? vahalo rosh ufeder bichlal kol hannetachim hayu, lamma yatzu? lefi shenneemar "vehifshit et haola venittach", en li ella netachim sheyyeshnan bichlal hafeshata, minnayin lerabbot et harosh shekkevar huttaz? talmud lomar "et rosho veet pidro vearach".
Middekaamar "et harosh shekkevar huttaz", mikkelal dishchita min hatztzavvar.
Vetanna patach berosh ufeder", umesayyem berosho ufidro"? hachi kaamar: minnayin lerabbot et harosh shekkevar huttaz? talmud lomar: "et harosh veet happader".
Verosho ufidro" lema li? mibbee leh lechidtanya: minnayin lerosh ufeder shekkodmin lechol hannetachim? talmud lomar: "et rosho veet pidro vearach".
b: Ufeder kamma dichtav rachamana lema li? mibbee leh lechidtanya: ketzad hu ose? chofe et happeder al bet hashshechita umaalehu, vezehu derech kavod shel mala.

Vehay tanna mayyte la mehacha, detanya: "zot torat habbehema vehaof", vechi beezo tora shavvta behema laof veof livhema? behema metammea bemagga uvemassa, of eno metamme bemagga uvemassa! of metamme begadim abbet habbelia, behema enah metammea begadim abbet habbelia!
Beezo tora shavvta behema leof veof livhema? lomar lach: ma behema bishchita – af of bishchita. i ma lehallan berov shenayim – af kan berov shenayim? talmud lomar: "zot".
Rabbi eliezer omer: beezo tora shavvta behema leof veof livhema? lomar lach: ma of hechshero min hatztzavvar, af behema hechsherah min hatztzavvar.
I ma lehallan "mimmul oref", af kan "mimmul oref"? talmud lomar: "umalak et rosho mimmul orpo velo yavdil" – rosho shel ze mimmul oref, veen rosho shel achar mimmul oref.
Verabbi eliezer, hay "zot" may aved leh? i lav "zot" hava amena: ma of besiman echad, af behema besiman echad, ketav rachamana "zot".

Tane bar kappara: "zot torat habbehema vehaof" – hetil hakkatuv leof ben behema ledagim, lechayyeyvo bishne simanin i efshar – shekkevar hukkash ledagim, lefotro belo kelum i efshar – shekkevar hukkash livhema. ha ketzad hechshero? besiman echad.
Dagim delav bene shechita ninhu, menalan? illema mishshum dichtiv: "hatzon uvakar yishshachet lahem im et kol dege hayyam yeasef lahem", baasifa bealma saggi lehu.

Ella meatta, gabbe selav dichtiv: "vayyaasfu et hasselav", hachi name delav bishchita? veha amrat: lefotro bivlo kelum i efshar, shekkevar hukkash livhema! hatam la ketiva asifa bimkom shechita deacharine, hacha ketiva asifa bimkom shechita deacharine.

Darash over galilaa: behema shennivret min hayyabbasha – hechsherah bishne simanim, dagim shennivreu min hammayim – hechsheran bivlo kelum, of shennivra min harkak – hechshero besiman echad. amar rav shemuel kappotkaa: teda, shehare ofot yesh lahen kaskeset beraglehem kaddagim.

Veod sheelo, katuv echad omer: "vayyomer elohim yishretzu hammayim sheretz nefesh chayya veof yeofef", alma mimmayya ibbero, uchetiv: "vayyitzer Adonai elohim min haadama kol chayyat hassade veet kol of hashshamayim", alma meara ibbero!
Amar lo: min harkak nivreu. raa talmidav mistakkelim ze baze, amar lahem: kashe beenechem sheddachiti et oyvi bekash? min hammayim nivreu, velamma hevian el haadam? likrot lahen shem.
Veyesh omrim: belashon acher amar leoto hegmon, uvallashon harishon amar lahen letalmidav, mishshum dichtiv al "vayyitzer".
Amar rav yehuda mishshum rabbi yitzchak ben pinchas: en shechita laof min hattora, shenneemar: "veshafach" – bishficha bealma saggi.
I hachi, chayya name! ittakkash lifsule hammukedashin. of name! ittakkash livhema, dichtiv: "zot torat habbehema vehaof". ha ketiv: "veshafach et damo".
Umay chazet deshadet leh al of? shadyeh achayya! mistabbera, mishshum desalek minneh.
(Siman: nitnabbel, dam, bimlika.)
Metivi: hashshochet venitnabbela beyado, hannocher vehameakker – patur millechassot. vei amrat en shechita laof min hattora, nechirato zo hi shechitato, live kissuy! mi savrat beof? la, bechayya.
Ta shema: hashshochet vetzarich laddam – chayyayv lechassot. ketzad hu ose? o nocharo o okro.

a: May lav beof, deka vae leh lidmeh leyanicha? la, bechayya deka vae leh lidmeh lelakka.
Ta shema: malak besakkin, metamme begadim abbet habbelia. vei amrat en shechita laof min hattora, nehi name dechi tavar leh shidra umafreket havya la terefa, tahne la sakkin letaharah midde nevela!
Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi omer: ma talmud lomar "ach kaasher yeachel et hatztzevi vegomer"? vechi ma lamadnu mitztzevi veayyal meatta?

Hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed, makkish tzevi veayyal lifsule hammukedashin: ma pesule hammukedashin bishchita – af tzevi veayyal bishchita; veof en lo shechita middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim.

Man tanna diflig aleh derabbi elazar hakkappar? rabbi hi, detanya: rabbi omer: "vezavachta … kaasher tzivviticha" – melammed shennitztavva moshe al havvevshet veal hakkane, veal rov echad baof, veal rov shenayim bivhema.

Echad baof ittemar: rav nachman amar: o vevshet o kane, rav adda bar ahava amar: vevshet velo kane. rav nachman amar: o vevshet o kane – "echad" katane, "echad" kol dehu. rav adda bar ahava amar: vevshet velo kane – may "echad"? meyuchad.
(Siman: shachat, chatzain, gargeret, pegima, dechattat haof.)

Metivi: shachat et havvevshet veachar kach nishmeta haggargeret – keshera, nishmeta haggargeret veachar kach shachat et havvevshet – pesula, shachat et havvevshet venimtzet gargeret shemuta veeno yodea im kodem shechita nishmeta im leachar shechita nishmeta – ze haya maase, veamru: kol safek bishchita – pesula, veillu shechita begargeret la katane.
Mishshum degargeret avida leishtemote.
Ta shema: shachat shene chatzae simanin beof – pesula, veen tzarich lomar bivhema. rabbi yehuda omer: baof – ad sheyyishchot et havvevshet veet havveridin, mishshum deveshet samuch livridin.
Ta shema: shachat chatzi gargeret, veshaha kede shechita acheret, vegamar shechitato – keshera. may lav beof, umay gemarah – gemarah legargeret? la, bivhema, umay gemarah – gemarah lishchita kulla.
Ta shema: hare shehaya chatzi kane pagum, vehosif alav kol shehu ugemaro – shechitato keshera. may lav beof, umay gemaro – gemaro lekane? la, bivhema, umay gemaro – gemaro levevshet.

Ta shema: ketzad molkin chattat haof? chotech shidra umafreket belo rov basar ad shemmaggia lavvevshet o lakkane; higgia lavvevshet o lakkane – chotech siman echad verov basar immo, uvaola – shenayim o rov shenayim. teyuveta derav adda bar ahava, teyuveta.
May have ala? may have ala?! kidkaamrat, dilma shane hatam, deikka shidra umafreket.
May? ta shema: dehahu bar avavza dahava be rava, ata ki memasmas koeh dema. amar rava: hechi naaved?
b: Nishchateh vahadar nivdekeh? dilma bimkom nekev kashachet! nivdekeh vahadar nishchateh? haamar rabba: vevshet en lo bedika mibbachutz ella mibbifnim!

Amar leh rav yosef bereh: nivdekeh lekane, venishchateh lekane velachshereh, vahadar lefchev leveshet velivdekeh. amar rava: chakkim yosef beri bitrefot kerabbi yochanan. alma echad dekaamar – o hay o hay.
Rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyishchot. amar rav chisda: lo amar rabbi yehuda ella beof, hoil vetzolehu kullo keechad, aval behema, kevan dimnattecha ever ever – la tzerich.
Lememra detama derabbi yehuda mishshum dam hu? vehatnan: rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyishchot et havvevridin.
Ema ad sheyyenakkev et havvevridin, umay "ad sheyyishchot"? ad sheyyinkov bishat shechita.
Ta shema: vevridin bishchita, divre rabbi yehuda. ema: vevridin tzarich lenakkevan bishat shechita, divre rabbi yehuda.
Ta shema: amru lo lerabbi yehuda, meachar shello huzekru vevridin ella lehotzi mehen dam, ma li bishchita, ma li shello bishchita? mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar bishchita.
Hachi kaamri la: ma li lenakkevan bishat shechita, ma li lenakkevan shello bishat shechita? vehu savar: bishat shechita ate dam dechayem, shello bishat shechita la ate dam dekarir.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: vevridin lerabbi yehuda, shaha bahen, daras bahen, mahu?
Amar leh hahu sava: hachi amar rabbi elazar, veamri la: amar leh hahu sava lerabbi elazar, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: menakkevan bekotz vehen kesherin.
Tanya kevavteh derav chisda: shachat shene chatzae simanin beof – pasul, veen tzarich lomar bivhema. rabbi yehuda omer: beof – ad sheyyishchot et havvevshet veet havvevridin.
Chatzi echad beof vechulei. ittemar: rav amar: mechetza al mechetza kerov, rav kahana amar: mechetza al mechetza eno kerov.
Rav amar: mechetza al mechetza kerov, hachi amar leh rachamana lemoshe: "la teshayyayr rubba". rav kahana amar: mechetza al mechetza eno kerov, hachi amar leh rachamana lemoshe: "shechot rubba".
(Siman: chatzi, kattina, gargeret, pegima).
Tenan: chatzi echad beof, veechad vachatzi babbehema – shechitato pesula. i amrat mechetza al mechetza kerov, ammay pasul? ha avad leh rov! midderabbanan, dilma la ate lemebad palga.
Amar rav kattina, ta shema: chalako lishnayim vehen shavin – shenehem temein, lefi shei efshar letzamtzem.
Ha efshar letzamtzem – tehorin, ammay tehorin? zil hacha ikka rubba, zil hacha ikka rubba!
Amar rav pappa: tere rubbe bechad mana lekka.
Ta shema: shachat chatzi gargeret, veshaha bah

a: Kede shechita acheret ugemarah, shechitato keshera. vei amrat mechetza al mechetza kerov, ittarfa la.
Mi savrat bivhema? la, beof! mimma nafshach: i mechetza al mechetza kerov – ha aved leh rubba, i mechetza al mechetza eno kerov – la avad velo kelum.
Ta shema: hare shehaya chatzi kane pagum, vehosif alav kol shehu ugemaro – shechitato keshera, vei amrat mechetza al mechetza kerov – terefa havya!
Amar rava: shane leinyan terefa, devaenan rov hannire laenayim.

Amar leh abbaye: vela kol dechen hu? uma terefa, divmashshehu mittarfa, hecha devaenan rubba – baenan rov hannire laenayim; shechita, dead deikka rubba la mittachshera – lo kol shekken devaenan rov hannire laenayim?
Ella, dechulle alma mechetza al mechetza eno kerov, vechi ittemar derav uderav kahana – leinyan pesach ittemar.
Hare shehayu yisrael mechetza tehorim umechetza temeim – rav amar: mechetza al mechetza kerov, verav kahana amar: mechetza al mechetza eno kerov.
Vehatam may tama derav, dichtiv "ish ish ki yihye tame lanefesh", ish nidche, veen tzibbur nidchin.
Rov echad baof, tenena chada zimna: rubbo shel echad kamohu!

Amar rav hoshaya: chada bechullin vachada bekadashim, utzericha, dei ashmeinan chullin – hatam hu desaggi leh berubba, mishshum delav ledam hu tzarich, aval kadashim dildam hu tzarich – ema la tisge leh berubba ad deikka kulleh.
Vei ashmeinan kadashim, mishshum dildam hu tzarich, aval chullin dildam la tzerich – ema befalga saggi leh, ka mashma lan.
He bechullin, vehe bekadashim?
Amar rav kahana: mistabbera resha bechullin vesefa bekadashim. mimmay? middekatane "hashshochet", vei salka datach resha bekadashim, "hammolek" mibbee leh.

Ella may, sefa bekadashim? "shechitato keshera"? "melikato keshera" mibbee leh! ha la kashya, ayyeyde desalek mibbehema tena name "shechitato keshera". ella resha, mikkede al of kae, i salka datach bekadashim – "hammolek" mibbee leh!
Rav shimi bar ashe amar: resha bechullin mehacha, dekatane "echad beof", vei salka datach bekadashim – ha ikka olat haof devae shene simanim!

Ella may, sefa bekadashim? rov echad beof – ha ikka olat haof devae shene simanin! may "rov echad"? rov kol echad veechad. uvedin hu delitne rov shenayim, kevan deikka chattat desaggi leh bechad siman – mishshum hachi la pesika leh.

Rav pappa amar: resha bechullin mehacha, dekatane: rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyishchot et havveridin, ufeligi rabbanan aleh. i amrat bishlama bechullin – shappir, ella i amrat bekadashim, ammay peligi rabbanan aleh? hu atzmo ledam hu tzarich!
Rav ashe amar: sefa bekadashim mehacha, dekatane: hashshochet shene rashin keechad – shechitato keshera. hashshochet – diavad in, lechattechilla la.
I amrat bishlama bekadashim – hayeynu dilchattechilla la, mishshum detane rav yosef: "tizbach" – shello yehe shenayim shochatim zevach echad, "tizbachuhu" – shello yehe echad shochet shene zevachim.
Veamar rav kahana: "tizbachehu" ketiv, ella i amrat bechullin – afillu lechattechilla name.

Veaf rabbi shimon ben lakish savar: resha bechullin, vesefa bekadashim, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: meachar sheshshaninu "rubbo shel echad kamohu", lamma shaninu "rov echad beof verov shenayim bivhema"?
Lefi sheshshaninu: heviu lo et hattamid, keratzo umerak acher shechitato al yado, yachol lo merak yehe pasul? lechach shaninu: rov echad beof verov shenayim bivhema.
Amar mar: yachol lo merak yehe pasul?
b: Im ken havya leh avoda beacher, vetanya: kol avodat yom hakkippurim enan kesherot ella bo.

Hachi kaamar: yachol yehe pasul midderabbanan, desalka datach amena ikka pasul midderabbanan, lechach shaninu: "rov echad beof verov shenayim babbehema", umeachar daafillu pesula derabbanan lekka, lema li lemarek? mitzva lemarek.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish mishshum levi sava: enah lishchita ella bassof, verabbi yochanan amar: yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof.
Amar rava: hakkol modim, hecha deshachat siman echad goy, vesiman echad yisrael – shehi pesula, shehare naase bah maase terefa beyad goy.
Beolat haof name, hecha demalak siman echad lematta vesiman echad lemala – pesula, shehare asa bah maase chattat haof lematta.

Lo nechleku ella kegon sheshshachat siman echad bachutz vesiman echad bifnim, leman deamar yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof – michayyayv, leman deamar enah lishchita ella bassof – la michayyayv.
Amar leh rabba bar shimi: mar la amar hachi, umannu rav yosef? hecha deshachat siman echad bachutz vesiman echad bifnim – name pasul, shehare asa bah maase chattat haof bachutz.
Lo nechleku ella kegon sheshshachat miut simanin bachutz ugemaro bifnim, leman deamar yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof – michayyayv, leman deamar enah lishchita ella bassof – la michayyayv.
Metiv rabbi zera: kol haasukin bappara mittechilla vead sof – metammein begadim, ufoslin otah bimlacha acheret.
Era bah pesul bishchitatah, ben kodem pesulah ben leachar pesulah – enah metammea begadim; behazzaatah: kodem pesulah – metammea begadim, leachar pesulah – enah metammea begadim.
Vei amrat yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof, liflog name bishchitatah: era bah pesul bishchita – kodem pesulah metammea begadim, leachar pesulah – enah metammea begadim!
Amar rava: nitkalkela shechita kaamrat? shane hatam, deiggallay milleta lemafrea delav shechita hi kelal.
Amar rava: i kashya li ha kashya li, leman deamar enah lishchita ella bassof, liflog behechshera defara, kegon deshachtuha bitre gavre, degavra kamma la metammea, vegavra batra metammea!
Amar rav yosef: tere gavre bechad zivcha kaamrat? bar minneh dehahu ditnena: "tizbach" – shello yehu shenayim shochatin zevach echad, "tizbachuhu" – shello yehe echad shochet shene zevachim.
Veamar rav kahana: "tizbachehu" ketiv.
Amar leh abbaye: lav ittemar ala, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi elazar berabbi shimon

a: Setimtaa, aval chachamim omrim shenayim shochatim zevach echad.
Ulerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, name liflog kegon dishchat chad gavra bishne sudarim, desudar kamma la metamme, vesudar batra metamme. ella bifsula defara ka mayyre, behechshera la ka mayyre.
Metiv rav idi bar avin: uvammoed lishmo – patur, shello lishmo – chayyayv.
Vehavenan bah: tama deshello lishmo, ha setama – patur.
Veammay patur? pesach bishar yemot hashshana shelamim hu! shema minna: pesach bishar yemot hashshana bae akira.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar gammada, nizreka mippi chavura veamru: hacha bemay askinan? kegon shehayu bealim temee metim, denidchin lefesach sheni, distama lishmo kae, vehay hu devae akira, ha acher la bae akira.

I amrat bishlama yeshnah lishchita mittechilla vead sof – ippesil leh mittechillat shechita, ella i amrat enah lishchita ella bassof – kevan dishchat beh pureta iddechi leh mippesach, iddach ki ka shachet shelamim ka shachet!
Amar leh abbaye: nehi deiddechi leh mippesach, middeme fesach mi iddechi?
Vechi tema, bae haamada vehaaracha, vehatnan: shachat bah shenayim o rov shenayim vaadayin hi mefarkeset – hare hi kechayya lechol devareha.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hashshochet bishnayim ushelosha mekomot, shechitato keshera. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: baenan shechita meforaat, velekka.
Veaf rabbi shimon ben lakish savar: baenan shechita meforaat, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: minnayin lashshechita shehi meforaat? shenneemar: "chetz shachut leshonam mirma dibber".
Metiv rabbi elazar: shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatin, afillu echad millemala veechad millematta – shechitato keshera. ammay? veha lekka shechita meforaat!
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya: mishnatenu besakkin echad ushene bene adam.

Amar leh rabbi abba: i hachi, hayeynu detane ala en choshshin shemma yitrefu ze al ze? i amrat bishlama bishte sakkinin ushene bene adam – shappir, mahu detema lechush dilma samchi ahadade, vehay la ate lemebad rubba vehay la ate lemebad rubba, ka mashma lan deen choshshin.
Ella i amrat besakkin achat ushene bene adam, hay "en choshshin shemma yitrefu ze al ze" – "shemma yidrosu ze al ze" mibbee leh.
Amar leh rabbi avin, teni: en choshshin
b: Shemma yidrosu ze al ze.
Metiv rabbi avin: shachat et havvevshet lematta veet hakkane lemala, o et havvevshet lemala veet hakkane lematta – shechitato keshera. ammay? veha lekka shechita meforaat!
Hu motev la, vehu mefarek la: bishchita haasuya kekulemos.

Hahu tora deishshechat bishnayim ushelosha mekomot, al rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta shekal mishufere shufere. amar leh rabbi zera: limmadtanu rabbenu mishnatenu bishne sakkinin ushene bene adam.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hechlid et hassakkin ben siman lesiman ufesako – pesula, tachat haor – keshera.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: o shehechlid et hassakkin tachat hashsheni ufesako – rabbi yeshevav omer: nevela, rabbi akiva omer: terefa.
I mimmatnitin, hava amena: hane mille – millematta lemala, dela kaaved kederech shechita, aval millemala lematta, dekaaved kederech shechita – ema shappir dame, ka mashma lan.
Tachat haor – keshera, be rav amri: tachat haor – eni yodea.
Ibbaya lehu: leve rav, deamri: tachat haor eni yodea, tachat matlet mahu? tachat tzemer mesubbach mahu? teku.
Bae rav pappa: hechlid bemiut simanim mahu? teku.

Mishna hashshochet shene rashin keechad – shechitato keshera. shenayim ochazin besakkin veshochatim, afillu echad lemala veechad lematta – shechitato keshera. hittiz et harosh bevat achat – pesula. haya shochet vehittiz et harosh bevat achat, im yesh bassakkin melo tzavvar – keshera.

Haya shochet vehittiz shene rashin bevat achat, im yesh bassakkin melo tzavvar echad – keshera. bamme devarim amurim? bizman sheholich velo hevi, o hevi velo holich, aval im holich vehevi, afillu kol shehu, afillu beizmel – keshera.
Gemara menahane mille? amar shemuel, deamar kera: "chetz shachut leshonam mirma dibber".
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshachat" – en "veshachat" ella umashach, vechen hu omer: "zahav shachut", veomer: "chetz shachut leshonam mirma dibber".
May "veomer"? vechi tema "zahav shachut" shennitvev kechut hu, ta shema: "chetz shachut leshonam".
Rava hava badek leh gira lerabbi yona bar tachlifa, veshachat be ofa bahade defarach. vedilma avid chalada? chazinan

a: Gidfe demipparmi.

Veha bae kissuy, vechi tema dimchassu leh, vehaamar rabbi zera amar rav: hashshochet tzarich sheyyitten afar lematta veafar lemala, shenneemar: "vechissahu beafar", "afar" lo neemar ella "beafar", melammed shehashshochet tzarich sheyyitten afar lematta veafar lemala!
Demazmen leh leafar dechulla pitka.
Haya shochet vehittiz, amar rabbi zera: melo tzavvar vechutz latztzavvar.
Ibbaya lehu: melo tzavvar vechutz latztzavvar kimlo tzavvar, dahavo la tere tzavvare, o dilma male tzavvar vechutz latztzavvar mashshehu?

Ta shema: haya shochet vehittiz shene rashin bevat achat, im yesh lassakkin melo tzavvar echad – kasher. may melo tzavvar echad? illema melo tzavvar echad vetu la, hasheta bivhema achat baenan melo tzavvar vechutz latztzavvar, bishte behemot saggi lehu kimlo tzavvar echad? ella peshita melo tzavvar chutz lishne tzavvarin.
Shema minna, melo tzavvar chutz latztzavvar, shema minna.
Bamme devarim amurim – bizman sheholich velo hevi vechulei. amar rav menashshe: beizmel sheen lo karnayim.
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav menashshe: machta may? amar leh: machta mivza baza.
Machta deushekafe, may? amar leh: tenena "afillu kol shehu". may lav machta deushekafe? la, izmel. izmel behedya katane la! paroshe ka mefaresh: may "kol shehu" – izmel.

Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach machta deushekafe, hasheta machta deushekafe sharya, izmel mibbaya? izmel itztericha leh, salka datach amena: ligzar izmel sheen lo karnayim attu izmel sheyyesh lo karnayim, ka mashma lan.
Mishna nafla sakkin veshachata, af al pi sheshshachata kedarkah – pesula, shenneemar: "vezavachta … veachalta", ma sheatta zoveach atta ochel.
Gemara tama denafla, ha hippilah hu – keshera, veaf al gav dela mikkavven.

Man tanna dela baenan kavvavna lishchita? amar rava: rabbi natan hi, detane oshaya zeera demin chavrayya: zarak sakkin lenootzah bakkotel, vehalcha veshachata kedarkah – rabbi natan machshir, vachachamim poslim. hu tane la, vehu amar la: halacha kerabbi natan.
Veha amra rava chada zimna, ditnan: vechullan sheshshachatu vaacherim roin otan – shechitatan keshera. veamrinan: man tanna dela bae kavvavna lishchita? veamar rava: rabbi natan hi.
Tzericha, dei ashmevinan hatam – mishshum deka mikkavven leshum chaticha beolam, aval hacha, dela ka mikkavven – ema la.
Vei ashmeinan hacha, mishshum dekaate mikkoach ben daat, aval hatam dela kaate mikkoach ben daat – ema la, tzericha.
Ittemar: nidda shenneensa vetavla, amar rav yehuda amar rav: tehora levetah, vaasura leechol bitruma. verabbi yochanan amar: af levetah lo tahara.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman, lerav deamar: tehora levetah vaasura leechol bitruma – avon karet (huttera) [hittarta], issur mita mibbaya?

Amar leh: balah chullin hu, vechullin la bae kavvavna. umena temra? ditnan: gal shennitlash uvo arbaim sea venafal al haadam veal hakkelim – tehorin. may lav adam dumeya dechelim? ma kelim dela mikkavvevni, af adam name la bae kavvavna.
Mimmay? dilma beyoshev umetzappe askinan, ematay yittalesh haggal,
b: Vechelim dumeya deadam, ma adam devaenan kavvavna, af kelim name deka mechavven lehu adam!
Vechi tema, beyoshev umetzappe, may lememra?
Mahu detema: ligzar mishshum chardalit shel geshamim, i name ligzar rashin attu kippin, ka mashma lan dela gazrinan!
