Umena temra dela matbelinan bechippin? ditnan: matbilin berashin, veen matbilin bechippin, sheen matbilin baavir.
Ella chullin dela bae kavvavna miha menalan? ditnan: perot shennaflu letoch ammat hammayim, ufashat mi sheyyadav temeot unetalan – yadav tehorot, uferot enan bechi yuttan".
Veim bishvil sheyyudechu yadav – tehorot, uferot bechi yuttan".
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: taval lechullin vehuchezak lechullin – asur lemaaser. huchezak – in, lo huchezak – la.
Hachi kaamar: af al pi shehuchezak lechullin – asur lemaaser.
Etiveh: taval velo huchezak – keillu lo taval. may lav: keillu lo taval kelal?
La, keillu lo taval lemaaser, aval taval lechullin. hu savar: daychoye ka medache leh. nefak dak veashkach, detanya: taval velo huchezak – muttar lachullin veasur lammaaser.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: lema tehve teyuveta derabbi yochanan meha?
Amar leh: rabbi yochanan hu deamar kerabbi yonatan ben yosef.
Detanya: rabbi yonatan ben yosef omer: "vechubbas", ma talmud lomar "shenit"? makkish tichboset sheniyya letichboset rishona: ma tichboset rishona ledaat, af tichboset sheniyya ledaat.
I ma lehallan baenan daat kohen, af kan baenan daat kohen? talmud lomar: "vetaher", mikkol makom.
Matkef la rav shimi bar ashe: umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna.

Utenan: nafla sakkin veshachata, af al pi sheshshachata kedarkah – pesula. vehavenan bah: tama denafla, ha hippilah hu – keshera, veaf al gav dela mikkavven. veamrinan: man tanna dela bae kavvavna lishchita? amar rava: rabbi natan hi.
Bishchita, afillu rabbi yonatan ben yosef [mode], middegalli rachamana mitassek bekadashim pasul – mikkelal dechullin la baenan kavvavna.
Verabbanan, nehi dela baenan kavvavna lizvicha, lachaticha baenan.

Amar rava: beha zechanhu rabbi natan lerabbanan, mi ketiv "vechatachta"? "vezavachta" ketiv, i baenan kavvavna lachaticha – afillu lizvicha name live, i la baenan kavvavna lizvicha – lachaticha name la live.
Hechi dame nidda shenneensa vetavla? ilema deansa chavirta veatbela, kavvavna dachavirta kavvavna meallayyta hi.
Veod, bitruma name achla, ditnan: hachereshet, vehashshota, vehassoma, veshennitrefa datah, im yesh lahen pikkechot metakkenot otan – ochlot bitruma.
Amar rav pappa: lerabbi natan, shennafla min haggesher, ulerabbanan, sheyyarda lehaker.
Amar rava: shachat para veshachat behema acheret immah, ledivre hakkol pesula.

a: Nishchata behema acheret immah, lerabbi natan – para pesula behema keshera, lerabbanan – para keshera behema pesula.

Peshita! nishchata behema acheret lerabbi natan itztericha leh, salka datach amena: "veshachat otah" amar rachamana, velo otah vachavertah, vehechi dame – kegon sheshshachat shete parot bahade hadade, aval behema dechullin ema la, ka mashma lan.
Chatach dallaat immah – divre hakkol pesula, nechtecha dallaat immah – divre hakkol keshera.
Mishna nafla sakkin vehigbihah, naflu kelav vehigbihan, hishchiz et hassakkin veaf, ba chavero veshachat, im shaha kede shechita – pesula. rabbi shimon omer: im shaha kede vikkur.
Gemara may kede shechita? amar rav: kede shechitat behema acheret.
Amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: kede shechitat behema livhema, veof leof, o dilma af behema leof?
Amar lehu: la hava bedichna beh bechabbivi, deeyshayyeyleh.
Ittemar: amar rav: kede shechitat behema livhema, veof leof, ushemuel amar: afillu behema leof, vechen ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: afillu behema leof.
Rabbi chananya amar: kede sheyyavi behema acheret veyishchot. yavi afillu mealma? natatta devarecha leshiurin!
Amar rav pappa: omedet lehattil ikka benayyhu.
Amri bemareva mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina: kede sheyyagbihenna veyarbitzenna veyishchot, dakka ledakka vegassa legassa.
Amar rava: hashshochet besakkin raa, afillu kol hayyom kullo – keshera.
Bae rava: shehiyyot, mahu sheyyitztarfu?
Vetifshot la middideh! hatam bidla sheha.
Bae rav huna bereh derav natan: shaha bemiut simanin, mahu? teku.
Rabbi shimon omer: im shaha [kede vikkur]. may kede vikkur? amar rabbi yochanan: kede bikkuro shel chacham. im ken, natatta devarecha leshiurin! ella, kede bikkur tabbach chacham.

Mishna shachat et havvevshet, ufasak et haggargeret, o fasak et haggargeret veachar kach shachat et havvevshet, o shachat echad mehen vehimtin lah ad shemmeta, o shehechlid et hassakkin tachat hashsheni ufesako – rabbi yeshevav omer: nevela, rabbi akiva omer: terefa.
Kelal amar rabbi yeshevav mishshum rabbi yehoshua: kol shennifsela bishchitatah – nevela, kol sheshshechitatah karauy vedavar acher garam lah lippasel – terefa, vehoda lo rabbi akiva.
Gemara shachat et havvevshet vechulei. vehoda lo rabbi akiva. ureminhi: ellu terefot babbehema
b: Nekuvat havvevshet ufesukat haggargeret!

Amar rava: la kashya, kan sheshshachat ulevassof pasak, kan sheppasak ulevassof shachat. shachat ulevassof pasak – nifselet bishchita hi, pasak ulevassof shachat – ki davar acher garam lah lippasel damya.
Etiveh rav acha bar huna lerava: shachat et havvevshet ufasak et haggargeret, pasak et haggargeret veachar kach shachat et havvevshet – nevela!
Ema: uchevar shachat et havvevshet meikkara.
Amar leh: shete teshuvot baddavar, chada dehayynu kammayyta, veod ha tenan "veachar kach"!
Ella amar rava: ellu asurot katane, veyesh mehen nevelot, veyesh mehen terefot.
Velichshov name dechizkiyya, deamar chizkiyya: asaah gistera – nevela, velichshov name derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: nittela yarech vechalal shellah – nevela.
Ki katane nevela, dela metammea mechayyim, aval nevela dimtammea mechayyim – la katane.

Rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: kan – sheshshachat bimkom chatach, kan – sheshshachat shello bimkom chatach. shachat bimkom chatach – nifsela bishchita hi, shello bimkom chatach – ki davar acher garam lah lippasel damya.

Umi amar rabbi shimon ben lakish hachi? vehaamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: shachat et hakkane veachar kach nikkeva harea keshera! alma keman demannecha bedikkula damya, hacha name keman demannecha bedikkula damya.
Ella amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: la kashya, kan kodem chazara, kan leachar chazara, umishna lo zaza mimmekomah.

Gufa, amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: shachat et hakkane veachar kach nikkeva harea – keshera. amar rava: la amar rabbi shimon ben lakish ella berea, hoil vechayye rea teluyin bakkane, aval bivne meayim – la.
Matkef la rabbi zera: meachar shennoldu bah simane terefa hittarta, ma li berea, ma li bivne meayim!
Vahadar beh rabbi zera, devae rabbi zera: nikkevu bene meayim ben siman lesiman, mahu? mi mitztaref siman rishon lesiman sheni letaharah mide nevela, o la?
Veamrinan: lav hayeynu devae ilfa: hotzi ubbar et yado ben siman lesiman, mahu?
